rv.q: Its biggest highlight is Adrian Lester’s Cyrano, who gives this production its sublimely wounded soul.
This time, McAvoy comes up with a breathtakingly career best performance, and the entire evening is a dazzling triumph.

cn.t: McAvoy commands in this poetic revival that honors Rostand's classic with heart, though Crimp's language-rich adaptation occasionally becomes too dense and self-indulgent, prioritizing verbal flourish over clarity.
